Wet dream of my life...
Nov 2025 • Family
When I was a Young boy I lived in Tunis for a couple of years where my parents worked under the reign of President Habib Bourgiba. Now, after almost 60 years, I still have "wet dreams" of the dinners at Chez Slah (same adress almost a half Century ago). 

My dinner started, always and repeatidly, with a "Brick a L'euf", continued with a "Piccata Milanese" and ended with - I don't remember what, mayby a "Banana Split" - I was totally filled up? Couldn't walk, we always took a taxi home to Av. El Menza!

Chez Stah was a heavenly experience! And I'm happy Chez Slah is still situated at Rue de Coubertine - one of the best and defining memories of my Life.

Not Great at All
Sep 2025 • Family
Not really impressed. We must have gotten to the restaurant early because the place was not busy at all, but we were seated outside. We were served by an older gentleman who did not seem too interested in his job or us. He was not rude, perhaps just tired of working. Up front he told us a few items listed on the menu were no longer available, even though we were there on a Saturday night. Our dinner was grilled fish - not bad - but nothing to write home about. This restaurant was suggested to us by a few folks in Tunis - and to be honest, I don't see the attraction. The meal was ok - the service ambiance less so.

To be absolutely avoided
Jun 2025 • Friends
Being and having been ... “Chez Slah” has been for decades one of Tunis’ most popular restaurants. Today the catering is of gargote level at completely indecent prices. 
The frying oil was obviously very useful before frying our golden squid. 
The dishes are sadly presented and we feel that the staff is only looking forward to you leaving as soon as possible. 
The offer of the menu is a distressing banality, the same as that of all the restaurants of the Goulette but the stratospheric prices, they, are legend. 
What a sadness to have wanted to please friends by inviting them to Slah’s and to have offered them such a poor experience while paying more than 90 dinars per person without having even caught fish by weight. If that had been the case I dare not imagine what vertiginous summit would have reached the note!
To be avoided absolutely and for the old only keep nostalgia for the glorious times of this restaurant
